summary_en: 600,000 ordinary shares cancelled (3.12% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Effective 2026-07-03. Post-cancellation shares outstanding: 20,503,514.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: Yamaura Corporation completed cancellation of 600,000 ordinary shares on 2026-07-03, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation was resolved at the Board meeting held on 2026-05-13. The cancelled shares represent 3.12% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury) prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, total shares outstanding (ex-treasury) are 20,503,514.
